title: Approximating a cubic path (Kurbo)
description: Kurbo flattens an original cubic path at three tolerances. The prepared polylines expose the precision-versus-segment-count tradeoff.
description_ko: Kurbo로 직접 만든 3차 곡선을 세 오차 허용치에서 선분으로 근사했어요. 정밀도와 선분 수의 관계를 비교하세요.
prompt: Approximating a cubic path. Edit the supplied Rust source and rerun the recipe to change computation inputs.
made_with: Rust 1.90.0; exact Cargo.toml/Cargo.lock; executed on macOS arm64 CPU
